topic: The Geometric Intuition of Linear Systems: Spaces and Inverses

sections.title: The Linear System as a Transformation
lecture_lines: A matrix maps a vector space to another.
Consider a robot arm moving to target.
Matrix A defines these transformation rules.
The grid deforms as A acts.
This visualizes the linear system Ax=b.
animations: Display basis vectors i and j in #FF5733.
Animate matrix A as a transformation grid deformation.
Show vector x being mapped to vector b using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] to represent the transformation process.
Highlight the linear dependency of the mapping.
Show the resulting vector b in #33FF57.

sections.title: Column Space: Where can the Robot go?
lecture_lines: The column space defines reachable territory.
Columns can span the whole space.
Dependence collapses space to a line.
animations: Visualize column space as a colored subspace #3357FF.
Display vectors spanning the column space using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg].
Show unreachable regions as empty space.

sections.title: Null Space: The 'Ghost' Inputs
lecture_lines: Null space contains vectors reaching zero.
animations: Show vectors mapped to the zero origin [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ghost.svg].
Highlight the null space subspace in #FF33A8.
Animate vanishing effect on non-unique input vectors [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ghost.svg].

sections.title: Inverse Matrices: The 'Rewind' Button
lecture_lines: They act as a rewind button.
animations: Animate transformation of vector x by A.
Represent inverse A^-1 as a return path using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/remote.svg].
Show point x returning to origin with #F3FF33.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Invertible matrices preserve the space structure.
Collapse implies singular or redundant systems.
animations: Flash labels for span, null, and inverse.
Zoom out to reveal the full synthesis.
